0022600215.text: The Sacramento Kings (1-9, on a three-game losing streak and 0-5 at home) host the Orlando Magic (2-7, on a four-game losing streak) in the Kings' 11th game of the 2026-27 season, with Sacramento 8 games back in the Pacific and Orlando 3.5 back in the Southeast. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (out, Achilles surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (out, dislocated knee), while Domantas Sabonis (knee soreness) and Keegan Murray (wrist soreness) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (out, knee), Jonathan Isaac (out, knee), Noah Penda (out, hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (out, ankle sprain), and the teams have not yet met this season, while the Kings lost both 2025-26 meetings, most recently 121-117 in Orlando on March 26, 2026.
